newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian sugar down on reduced demand, better supply.
newsitem.headline: Indian sugar down on reduced demand, better supply.

text.p: Sugar prices extended losses on local markets on Wednesday on poor consumer demand and increased supply, dealers said.
In the ready delivery, sugar S-30 fell five rupees to 1,250/1,270 rupees per quintal while M-30 fell by the same amount to 1,280/1,360 per quintal.
"Arrivals improved in the market following renewed offerings by mill owners," one trader said.
Sugar mill delivery fell to 1,185/1,200 rupees from 1,185/1,210 rupees per quintal.
Overall, sentiment was subdued at close in light trade and traders said they expected range-bound trade in the days leading up to the budget presentation on February 28.
